rows.derivation: Format 'FREE { data-name-1 } ...': three FREE statements with 3/2/2 operands compile and each operand is processed (see GR rows). S1 FREE P N Q (P,Q alias one ALLOCATEd area, N NULL): P a) released+NULL, N b) no action, Q c) EC (storage no longer currently allocated) -> EC1 + 'S1 P=NULL N=NULL Q=SAME'; reverse order would free via Q and raise on P, so it pins GR2's order. S2 FREE R P (R = ADDRESS OF WORKING-STORAGE): R c) EC, unchanged; nonfatal so resume at next implicit FREE: P a) NULL -> EC2 + 'S2 R=SAME P=NULL'. S3 FREE Q P (Q = allocation UP BY 1, not the start): EC3, Q unchanged, P NULL. END K=3 (b) raised nothing). T fields are PIC X(8) so 'NULL'/'SAME' carry 4 inner pad spaces.
